skills.name: Fan Dance (扇舞/扇の舞)
skills.line: Hmph! You're not stopping me from pursing my dream!
skills.description:
Kingyo Hime charges at a single target and whacks them with her fan, dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK.
If her Goldfish is on the the battlefield, its HP is restored by 10% of Kingyo Hime's max HP and it gains a layer of Fan Dance, max of 5 layers. ;Fan Dance (扇の舞) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Each layer increases ATK by 20%.

skills.name: Goldfish: Counter (金鱼·反击/金魚·反撃)
skills.line: Don't you dare try to bully me, you scoundrel!
skills.description: When the enemy team takes 8 actions, Kingyo Hime's Goldfish attacks all enemies dealing damage equal to 120% of its ATK and has a 25% base chance of inflicting them with Silence, lasts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Goldfish: Aid (金鱼·助阵/金魚·協力)
skills.line: Goldfish, let's go rule the world!
skills.description:
Kingyo Hime summons a Goldfish who can use Fish Fury. When an ally receives damage from a single-target attack, the Goldfish takes 40% of the damage for them (takes priority over Soul Edge's effect) until the attack is completed. Each attack only triggers this effect once per turn.
Her Goldfish inherits 48% of Kingyo Hime's HP, 100% of her ATK and 100% of her SPD. ; : ;Goldfish (金魚) : A summoned entity. :''(Uses ally summon spot.)''

upgrades.text: Fish Fury has a 50% chance of reducing the target's move bar by 30%.

skills.name: Fish Fury (金魚の恐り)
skills.description: Kingyo Hime's Goldfish launches a water grenade at 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

bio.condition: Have Kingyo Hime gain 50000 Realm or Entrust EXP.
